candidate_intervention_inputs.quantification: At fixed refrigeration service, allocate4.08MMT across existing equipment cohorts; multiply cohort emissions by adoption and residual leakage/GWP improvement. Apply leak management and replacement sequentially on shared cohorts.
candidate_intervention_inputs.missing: charge mass and refrigerant species/GWP, actual leak rate, U.S./global split, system age, replacement schedule and cost, incremental electricity, technician capacity
candidate_intervention_inputs.horizon: adoption by2031; annual steady-state impact, not cumulative

candidate_intervention_inputs.intervention: Electricity efficiency and additional clean supply
candidate_intervention_inputs.quantification: MWh saved times appropriate marginal/attributional emissions factors; then procurement on residual load. Maintain floor area, opening hours, refrigeration service and merchandise throughput. Track location and market accounting separately.
candidate_intervention_inputs.control: direct demand and procurement; grid largely external
candidate_intervention_inputs.missing: MWh by country/end-use/hour, residual equipment stock, project capex, tariffs, grid factors, procurement terms

candidate_intervention_inputs.intervention: Fleet efficiency/electrification and stationary heat electrification
candidate_intervention_inputs.quantification: Fuel savings at fixed delivered tonne-km; heat pumps at fixed useful heat. Net Scope1 decrease against added Scope2 and upstream fuel/electricity effects.
candidate_intervention_inputs.missing: fuel species/volumes, transport-refrigerant split, tonnes/miles/hours, heat load/COP, electricity factors, asset replacement capacity

candidate_intervention_inputs.intervention: Food prevention, donation and disposal treatment
candidate_intervention_inputs.quantification: CY2025 landfill/incineration644101t is bounded physical pool, not entirely preventable. Split edible/avoidable and landfill/incineration, food categories and sites; hold edible food service fixed, reduce procurement for prevented waste. Account upstream avoided production only where displaced, and residual treatment separately.
candidate_intervention_inputs.control: direct inventory and handling; suppliers and disposal contractors shared
candidate_intervention_inputs.missing: avoidable fractions, food-category composition, sold tonnes, landfill methane capture, disposal split, program costs and displacement evidence

candidate_intervention_inputs.quantification: Build product-specific life-cycle inventory and allocated Walmart purchasing quantities. Do not apply arbitrary reduction rate to635MMT or claim Gigaton reductions as inventory abatement.
candidate_intervention_inputs.control: supplier influence/shared, customer use largely indirect
candidate_intervention_inputs.missing: category-resolved Scope3, product quantities, supplier-specific factors, attribution, physical product lifetime and use assumptions
